ambient_space.description: Long space, wider image, light dynamics processing.
ambient_space.applicability: A starting point for layering space around sustained sounds, pads and strings.
ambient_space.caveat: Uses only the existing shared convolution return and width processing; no shimmer, granular or adaptive space.
ambient_space.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

cinematic.description: Wide, deep, big dynamics; long reverb.

funk_disco.description: Drums and bass up front, tight rhythm.
funk_disco.applicability: For rhythmic arrangements where drums, bass and harmony instruments answer each other.
funk_disco.caveat: No beat tracking or automatic groove correction; the balance between parts still depends on the source and the keep amount.
funk_disco.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

heavy_rock_metal.description: Guitar contour; keeps definition in dense parts.
heavy_rock_metal.applicability: For dense arrangements of electric guitars, drums and bass.
heavy_rock_metal.caveat: No amp simulation or drum replacement; low-crest sources trigger the existing compression safeguard, so still check the master dynamics.
heavy_rock_metal.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

house_dance.description: Focused low end, brighter and wider.
house_dance.applicability: For electronic dance stems driven by the low end and the drums.
house_dance.caveat: No tempo-synced kick pumping, beat-synced delay or automatic arrangement; do not read the name as promising these.
house_dance.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

indie_pop.description: Midrange and vocal contour, moderate space.
indie_pop.applicability: For arrangements carried by guitars, keys and vocals together.
indie_pop.caveat: The name does not stand for any artist's sound; adjust to the performance intent and your reference.
indie_pop.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

jazz_natural.applicability: For jazz and acoustic stems that already carry their own room and dynamics.
jazz_natural.caveat: Still uses the existing per-track processing and master chain; not a straight pass-through or a rebuild of the live recording.
jazz_natural.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

pop_2020s.description: Modern pop: bright, vocal forward, tight low end.

reggae_groove.applicability: A starting point for arrangements built on the bass-and-rhythm relationship.
reggae_groove.caveat: Not a dub effects rack: no tempo echo, delay throws or rhythmic feedback.
reggae_groove.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

rnb_soul.applicability: For stems where rhythm and vocals weigh equally; keeps the backing supportive.
rnb_soul.caveat: Not a recreation of any particular era, artist or gear; check dense vocals with a level-matched A/B.
rnb_soul.numeric_basis: Starting values tuned by UTUVO; not a guarantee of sound quality.

rock.description: Thick mids, punchy drums, wide guitars.

trap.description: Deep 808s, crisp hats, vocal up close.
